name: StationGodMCP
instructions: StationGod reads and builds in a running Stationeers world. Tool descriptions are short: tool_info {tool: "<name>"} gives a tool's full help in small steps, and tool_info {} lists the shared topics (positions, turns, refunds, paging, shaping, truncation, cheats, jobs, gateways, player, networks, errors). Start with list_devices or describe_device before reading or writing logic. Building tools dry-run by default; a real run needs dry_run false and confirm true. Cheat tools need the user's approval for each call. Replies stay small: read truncated before concluding you saw everything, and use fields, omit or output_file for a large reply. An error's see names the tool_info node that explains it.
